source: LLM lexicon from archive.org PacManNESHiResScans (searchable PDF) + controllability.py + object_tables.py. Written 2026-10-18 after the parse freeze for this pair. Single-screen maze: score is the metric.

parse.judge: MiMo as model behind the prompt

notes: Eat dots, avoid ghosts, use energizers to eat them back.
Combo: 200/400/800/1600 per energizer run. Fruit: cherry 100 → orange 500.
10000 points = extra life. Start with 3 lives.

facts.statement: Eat everything in sight (dots) to clear the maze.
Avoid being caught by Blinky, Pinky, Inky and Clyde.
After an energizer, ghosts turn blue and can be eaten.
Ghosts are worth 200/400/800/1600 points in one combo.
SELECT chooses one or two players.

goal.statement: Eat all dots in the maze while avoiding (or eating, when energized) the four ghosts.

concepts.name: dot
concepts.statement: small pellets to eat for progress

concepts.name: energizer
concepts.statement: large pellet that turns ghosts blue

concepts.name: ghost
concepts.statement: Blinky, Pinky, Inky, Clyde — avoid or eat when blue

citation.quote: ghosts, Blinky, Pinky, Inky, and Clyde

realisation.types_why: object_tables.py scan: types 0x1d60/HP 0x060. HP 187→182 under B+UP — ghost or fruit HP.

economy.statement: Ghost combo 200/400/800/1600; fruit 100-500; 10000 points = extra life.

target_px_why: generic floor rule. Single-screen maze: score is the metric, read from screen by HudReader. No scroll, no position byte.
